description: pixel art item icon, dark modern Korean urban horror setting, clean outline, detailed shading. One item only, it fills most of the square, transparent background. Each item stays fully inside its own square and does not touch the edges. No pedestal, no stand, no display base, no plate, no text, no letters, no numbers, no extra objects.

items.en: pixel art item icon, dark modern Korean urban horror setting, clean dark outline around the whole object, detailed shading. a silicone hip-shaped torso toy seen from behind, three-quarter rear view, pale beige silicone lower torso without legs: narrow waist cut flat at the top, wide hips, two round buttocks with a clear vertical cleft between them, short thigh stumps cut flat at the bottom, sitting on the floor. Only this item, nothing else beside it, no text, no halo or glow outside the object's outline, fully inside its square.

pixel art item icon, dark modern Korean urban horror setting, clean dark outline around the whole object, detailed shading. an eye-only half mask, front view, wide and flat: the top edge sweeps outward into two pointed tips at the far left and right, the bottom edge cuts up into a deep V notch at the center where the nose goes, two narrow almond-shaped eye holes slanting slightly upward, smooth hard lacquered shell, sleek and elegant. Not an animal head: absolutely no ears, no horns, no fur, no snout, no beak sticking out, the outline stays a smooth mask shape. The animal is only hinted at by a stylized shape of the edge and a faint engraved pattern. Plain glossy deep navy-black surface, single color, engraving in slightly lighter dark grey. Lion hint, shown by the outline shape and not by patterns: the top edge rises into five short flame-like mane points in a row like a low crown, heavy straight brow, slanted eye holes. The bottom edge ends right under the eyes. It stays a narrow half mask covering only the eyes and upper nose, never the muzzle, snout, mouth, cheeks or jaw, and no animal face is drawn on it. Only this item, nothing else beside it, no text, no halo or glow outside the object's outline, fully inside its square.
